When will my ECG results and Doctor\'s diagnosis be ready?

After the clinic Nurse completes your 90-second ECG recording, it is uploaded securely for your assigned Doctor to review. For your clinical safety, raw waveforms and medical notes remain hidden under Awaiting Doctor Review until your Doctor confirms the diagnosis and releases the results to you.
How do I view my Doctor\'s prescription, care plan, and clinical advice?

Once your Doctor releases your results, open the Reports tab on the bottom navigation bar and tap the session. You can read your Doctor\'s clinical impression, follow-up instructions, prescribed medications and dosages, and download your official PulseLink Released Report PDF.
What do the statuses on my Session Status page mean?

Awaiting Doctor Review means your clinic ECG recording has been uploaded safely and your Doctor is reviewing the trace. Results Released means your Doctor has finalised and released your clinical notes and prescription, which can now be viewed under Reports.
How do I find a nearby clinic or hospital in Gqeberha?

Open the SOS tab on the bottom navigation bar and tap Facility Finder & Maps. You can filter verified public Hospitals, Clinics and Community Health Centres, zoom in or out on the map, inspect facility entrances and launch turn-by-turn directions in Google Maps.
How do I message my clinic Nurse using Live Chat?
Tap Live Chat or Contact Support at the top of this Help & Support screen to send a direct message to the clinic Nurse for appointment, report-status or non-urgent support questions.
What should I do in a medical emergency (SOS)?

PulseLink is a remote monitoring prototype and does not dispatch ambulances automatically. If you experience chest pain, shortness of breath or a medical emergency, tap the SOS tab immediately to dial 112 (National Emergency) or 10177 (Ambulance).
How is my personal health data protected?

Your profile and released reports are protected with Firebase Authentication, optional biometric lock (fingerprint or face unlock), encrypted HTTPS transport and role-based clinical access. Patients can only view recordings linked to their verified account after Doctor release.
